# OASIS interoperability fixture

`apt1.json` is the STIX 2.1 APT1 example published by OASIS Open at:

https://oasis-open.github.io/cti-documentation/examples/example_json/apt1.json

SHA-256: `f893d6a93589e39f3ec9314ec50d16eb9b7a717f562ae08de8355bff950dc145`

It is redistributed unchanged under the repository's BSD 3-Clause license.
The source revision is pinned through this repository's lockstep test history;
refreshes must be reviewed as fixture changes.
